chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, who said:

I entered upon Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) and asked him to write so that I might look at his handwriting and recognize it when it arrived. He said, “Yes.” Then he said, “O Ahmad, the handwriting will differ for you between a thick pen and a fine pen, so do not doubt.” Then he called for the inkpot and wrote, and he kept drawing ink from the course of the inkpot. I said to myself while he was writing, “I will ask him to give me the pen with which he wrote.” When he finished writing, he turned to speak to me while wiping the pen with the inkpot’s cloth for a while, then he said, “Here, O Ahmad.” So he handed it to me.

I said, “May I be made your ransom, I am distressed by something that affects me within myself, and I had wanted to ask your father, but that was not decreed for me.” He said, “And what is it, O Ahmad?” I said, “My master, it has been narrated to us from your forefathers that the sleep of the Prophets is on their backs, the sleep of the believers is on their right sides, the sleep of the hypocrites is on their left sides, and the sleep of the satans is on their faces.” He (عليه السلام) said, “That is so.” I said, “My master, I strive to sleep on my right side, but I am not able, and sleep does not come to me upon it.” He remained silent for a while, then said, “O Ahmad, come near me.” So I came near him, and he said, “Put your hand beneath your clothes.” So I put it in. Then he took out his hand from beneath his clothes and put it beneath my clothes, and he wiped with his right hand my left side and with his left hand my right side three times.
Ahmad said: Since he (عليه السلام) did that to me, I have not been able to sleep on my left side, and sleep does not come to me upon it at all.

key_terms.الدَّوَاةِ: the inkpot from which ink was drawn
key_terms.الشَّيَاطِينِ: the satans, whose sleep is described as being on their faces
key_terms.الْقَلَمِ: the pen with which the Imam wrote
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers, whose sleep is described as being on the right side
key_terms.الْمُنَافِقِينَ: the hypocrites, whose sleep is described as being on the left side
key_terms.خَطِّهِ: his handwriting, used for recognition of the Imam’s written correspondence
key_terms.نَوْمَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: the manner of sleep attributed to the Prophets
key_terms.يَمِينِي: my right side, the side on which Ahmad wished to sleep

ai.seo_question: What does a hadith from al-Kafi report about the sleeping positions of Prophets, believers, hypocrites, and satans?
ai.summary: This narration relates an encounter with Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) in which Ahmad ibn Ishaq first seeks a sample of the Imam’s handwriting and then asks about a transmitted teaching concerning sleeping positions. The Imam (عليه السلام) confirms the report and then physically treats Ahmad, after which Ahmad says he could no longer sleep on his left side.
